key_insight: The NLCE+QA framework successfully computes thermodynamic-limit properties using a 20-qubit trapped-ion quantum processor.
engineering_relevance: This work demonstrates the potential of quantum algorithms to extract valuable physical insights from small-scale quantum computations.
method: Applied numerical linked-cluster expansion with quantum algorithms (NLCE+QA).
Utilized projector-based block-diagonalization schemes for efficient computation.
Obtained final expectation values via a novel CX-test alternative to the Hadamard test.
evidence_signal: The study investigates the accuracy of expectation values generated by current quantum hardware under specific model conditions.
watch_item: The amplification of measurement noise poses a significant challenge to the reliability of results.
paper_title: Thermodynamic-limit dispersion relations on trapped-ion quantum hardware
